question: Can a ground-truth-free per-cell boundary-sensitivity score identify which quantitative single-cell measurements are trustworthy despite segmentation uncertainty?
scope: Matched cell identities only; not missing cells, split/merge topology failures, or de novo segmentation.

method.perturbations: binary erosion and dilation of each Mesmer cell by 1.0 um in a local crop
method.primary_score: symmetric normalized span of integrated signal between eroded and dilated masks
method.primary_true_error: symmetric absolute percentage error of raw Mesmer integrated signal versus matched manual-GT cell
method.comparator: geometry-only symmetric area span under the same +/-1.0 um perturbation

development.dataset: TissueNet TRAIN subset previously selected for Histo08

stop_condition: If TissueNet development fails, do not evaluate UNSEG. If UNSEG fails, stop Histo10 rather than tuning the score on UNSEG.
